chains.label: Fate doctrine, Red Lotus and Spring Autumn Cicada
chains.mechanism_owner: Fang Yuan owns and deliberately activates his vital Spring Autumn Cicada. Red Lotus's inherited Spring Autumn Success is a separate prepared method.

evidence.evidence_kind: Duke Long's determinism is attributed doctrine in an inheritance memory; Hong Ting cannot prevent parents' deaths despite intervention; Red Lotus challenges Fate after grief and proposes revival, with no proven general resurrection.
evidence.limit: Prophecy/role prediction is not a universal invulnerability contract or proof every future event is fixed.

evidence.evidence_kind: Fang deliberately activates his vital Rank-six Cicada; current body, cultivation and other Gu are sacrificed as propulsion. His sub-ten-percent success estimate is his model. The will/consciousness arrives in an earlier body and the Cicada is too weak for immediate reuse.
evidence.limit: Specific activation only; no automatic reset from arbitrary death, no demonstrated player memory transfer, repeated-use guarantee, or costless return.

member.blocks: 25-46; the no-shortcut/Fate Gu goal claim is blocks 47-66

evidence.evidence_kind: Red Lotus's inheritance supplies Spring Autumn Success, described as removing Spring Autumn Cicada failure chance while lowering luck; source also establishes the island's finite, non-obvious access context.
evidence.limit: Prepared named inheritance and tradeoff; it is not a universal time ability.

chains.knowledge: Fang carries memories through the owned Gu activation; others see consequences and may hold separate prior-life records. The reader's later chronology does not make witnesses omniscient. Fang's prior-life forecast can diverge from the active pass.
unknowns: Exact repeat-use probability outside Fang's attributed estimate
Exact rewind span and other observers' fate for every activation
Whether unrelated actors retain memories without a defined carrier

chains.label: Fate Gu destruction, redistribution and conditional Venerable ascent
chains.mechanism_owner: Heaven Overseeing Tower/Duke Long uses Fate Gu; Fang destroys it; Red Lotus and Giant Sun's prepared method later redistributes Fate into people. Lu Wei Yin supplies the ascension model as testimony.

evidence.evidence_kind: Fate Vanquish still harms other combatants while Fang's complete otherworldly-demon form alone resists its effect; Fang then crushes rank-nine Fate Gu.
evidence.limit: Exception does not transfer to Fang's allies, every otherworldly actor, all future venerables, or all forms of Fate. Chapter ends before consequences.

evidence.evidence_kind: Duke Long's re-refinement/exclusive-use comments are strategic assertions. Later event distributes Fate into living people through human will/luck; narrator states it can no longer be used by Heaven's Will. The event causes deaths/pain and merges the five regions.
evidence.limit: Fate Gu, distributed Fate, Heaven's Will and ordinary causality remain distinct. Distribution is not universal annihilation of fate/cause or proof Heaven's Will itself vanished.

evidence.evidence_kind: Lu Wei Yin describes four ascension conditions and several separate Heavenly Dao blockades; his explanations of revival and Dao Lord power are testimony. Fang has explicit deficits at this point.
evidence.limit: Fate's altered state removes/changes one obstacle but does not supply attainment, essence, marks or every blockade. Star Constellation revival is only likely in Lu's account.

evidence.evidence_kind: Fang's ascent is realized later through hidden rank-nine timing and prepared counters; opponents' explanations are partly inference. He remains badly injured and asset-depleted afterward.
evidence.limit: Later realized strength does not retroactively protect an earlier body, force earlier ascension, or guarantee safety.

chains.knowledge: Combatants see Fate Gu destroyed; later the distribution mechanism and Red Lotus/Giant Sun preparation are revealed in stages. Duke Long's claims and rival venerables' deductions must retain speaker attribution.
unknowns: Complete final fate of Heaven's Will
Individual distribution/effect of each heaven-path mark
Full revival requirements beyond the supplied claims

chains.label: Probability, Stories, Oldest Dream protection and limits
chains.mechanism_owner: Scenario/Star Stream governs Probability; named Stories, audience and sponsors support particular interventions; Oldest Dream's attention sustains lines but the watcher has limited direct control.

evidence.evidence_kind: Time-space support slows one Probability backlash at a cost; audience Probability raises a specific attack grade, but linked lives and timer make Dokja cancel. A reported world-line restoration promise is unfulfilled in the reviewed scene.
evidence.limit: Support affects a named resolution; it does not guarantee survival or goal completion. Cost/withdrawal and connected actors remain material.

evidence.evidence_kind: Oldest Dream child's denial sphere resists Dokja's attack but the Plotter crosses it; the Plotter cuts traumatic memories rather than killing him, and companions comfort him until he wakes and chooses the child's world.
evidence.limit: A source-specific protection and chosen nonlethal resolution. Not universal immunity, eternal life, or restoration of every loss.

evidence.evidence_kind: Watcher attention is stated to sustain world-lines, but watcher cannot protect passengers at the original scenario. Foreign Jae-hwan breaches the train through Fourth Wall limits; the system ejects tail cars and blocks reboarding across the time-axis barrier.
evidence.limit: Attention/world-sustaining authority is not fine-grained control, combat immunity, or guaranteed intervention. Foreign means expose an actual boundary counter.

chains.knowledge: Child, watcher, companions, Plotter, scenario system and outside intruder hold different information. Later revelation of Oldest Dream does not grant earlier witnesses the explanation.
unknowns: Full ceiling and controllability of watcher authority
General resistance/counter rules for foreign-world powers
Whether any later hospital event completes recovery

chains.label: Regression, world-lines and the specific author/reader origin loop
chains.mechanism_owner: Joonghyuk chooses a specific Regression Stigma; Dokja creates/transfers it; Biyoo explains branch selection. Sooyoung authors a specific backward-linked serial after a Final Wall transition.

evidence.evidence_kind: Joonghyuk knowingly accepts memory/relationship loss and ends the 0th turn by choice. Biyoo attributes branch choice to Regression; post-scenario-born people are excluded and travel misroutes participants.
evidence.limit: Biyoo's topology account is attributed testimony. Regression does not erase every other line's loss or include every actor.

evidence.evidence_kind: Narration presents continuous subject-time across branches. Another-line Bo-Ri does not undo the original death; one-use Ark arrives twenty years late, the rescue fails, and Joonghyuk loses regressor category/stigmas.
evidence.limit: A branch/transport can supply another person's life or later route without restoring the original actor/state.

evidence.evidence_kind: 1863rd-turn Sooyoung reaches the first world-line at age 13, meets 15-year-old Dokja, then writes the 1,863-regression serial at bodily cost. Her belief that omitting the novel could omit the person it saved, and the King's simultaneous cause/effect explanation, are attributed. Fourth Wall's dispersed-soul/world-maintenance explanation also stays attributed; final hospital restoration is unresolved.
evidence.limit: This is a specific authored causal loop, not proof that future power alone reaches backward, or that authorial knowledge guarantees the desired ending. Source stops before recovery is confirmed.

chains.knowledge: Each Joonghyuk turn, parallel line, Sooyoung at two ages, Dokja watcher/child/avatar and their different memory shares must remain separate. Later author/reader knowledge is not shared with earlier actors by default.
unknowns: Whether distributed Dokja is restored at the cutoff
Exact operation of causal simultaneity beyond the King's explanation

original_design_proposals: Gate retrocausal interaction on an actually owned time mechanism, reachable era, trigger and retained knowledge; future rank or reader foreknowledge alone grants no past-facing action.

Author fate-save scope and exception owner explicitly; remove only the rule/actor's actual dependency when fate is severed. Preserve Heaven's Will, world causality and independent goals unless their own state changes.
Track a branch's outcome separately from losses in the abandoned line, and distinguish survival from completing a player's intended goal.
Carry genuinely source-backed unlimited protections at their evidenced scope without inventing a balancing meter; where support or a counter is observed, preserve that exact condition.
validation: Static claim/locator and input-hash review; no tests, build, browser, game actions, source writes or private-save access.
